<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-macro "<!ENTITY ent-val 'Resolved Entity Value'>">
  %ent-macro;
  <!ENTITY ext-ent SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin-data SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Primary catalog comment describing the root element and namespace usage -->
  <item id="1">
    <?catalog-action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &ent-val;, and other raw content.
    ]]>
    &ent-val;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param-entity "<!ENTITY sec-entity 'Internal Security Token'>">
  %param-entity;
  <!ENTITY base-entity "&sec-entity; - Expanded">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc-file SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="archive-manager" status="active"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive container comment detailing metadata constraints -->
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with entity reference: &base-entity; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    <?dc-pi creator="John Doe"?>
    &base-entity;
  </record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA | details)*> <!ELEMENT details (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <!ENTITY ref-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ref-b "&ref-a; Beta">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY notes SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-info version="1.0" author="TestBed"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.net/inventory" xmlns:custom="http://example.net/custom">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment highlighting dynamic entities -->
  <product id="p1">
    <?custom-action trigger="load"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Multi-line CDATA block:
      Line 1: &ref-b;
      Line 2: <element>text</element>
    ]]>
    <details>&ref-b;</details>
  </product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE workspace [
  <!ELEMENT workspace (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY dynamic-val 'Dynamic Parameter Content'>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ENTITY combined "&dynamic-val; and Static Extension">
  <!NOTATION json SYSTEM "application/json">
  <!ENTITY payload SYSTEM "data.json" NDATA json>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<workspace xmlns="http://example.org/ws" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Workspace configuration comment for namespace parsing -->
  <node>
    <?ns-action mode="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA container with markup: <node id="test">&combined;</node>
    ]]>
    &combined;
  </node>
</workspace>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % core-macro "<!ENTITY core-ref 'Core Definition'>">
  %core-macro;
  <!ENTITY extended-ref "&core-ref; Extended">
  <!NOTATION xml SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY schema SYSTEM "schema.xml" NDATA xml>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="interactive"?>
<registry xmlns="http://example.com/registry" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Registry root comment verifying CDATA and entity interactions -->
  <entry xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <?registry-log event="access"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload inside CDATA containing entity &extended-ref; and tags <entry>.
    ]]>
    &extended-ref;
  </entry>
</registry>
```
